question: What kinds of devotion must be absent in those unfit to receive the teaching?
premises: Some persons lack devotion to the kula
Some persons lack devotion to the guru
Such persons are marked as unfit
inference: Those devoid of devotion to the kula and the guru are unfit recipients.
plain_english: Indeed, in one devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
